votes.context: Mr. Gallagher moved to excuse Mr. Powell from tonight's Council meeting, and Mr. Colvin seconded.
Mrs. Miller moved to approve the minutes for the Council meeting on September 8th, 2026, as written, and Mr. Nation seconded.
Mr. Lauffer moved to waive the two-reading rule for Ordinance 2026-040, and Mrs. Miller seconded the motion.
Mr. Lauffer moved to adopt Ordinance 2026-040 as an emergency, and Mr. Colvin seconded the motion.

Ordinance No. 2026-041 Authorizing the Village Manager to Execute a Contract to Purchase Real Property Located on Third Street from John R. Purdum and Mary Jo Purdum and Declaring an Emergency Mr. Colvin moved to waive the two-reading rule for Ordinance 2026-041, and Mr. Nation seconded the motion.
